name: two-approvals
title: One fix, *two approvals*
subtitle: How my AI agents fix a memory alert, and the two places I say yes.
footer: APPROVING A CHANGE ISN'T APPROVING AN ACTION

lanes.label: APPROVAL 2 · AN ACTION ON THE CLUSTER

nodes.title: Opens a pull request
nodes.desc: The limit is too low, so it raises it in Git.

nodes.title: I merge it
nodes.desc: A yes to a change to one file.

nodes.title: Syncs Git to the cluster
nodes.desc: The StatefulSet gets the new limit.

nodes.title: Keeps the old limit
nodes.desc: It changes only when it is deleted.

nodes.title: Checks again
nodes.desc: Git and the pod disagree. No new pull request.

nodes.title: I approve the call
nodes.desc: A yes to one delete, with its arguments.

nodes.title: Back with the new limit
nodes.desc: The StatefulSet rebuilds it from Git.

steps.text: Grafana fires a memory alert. The dispatcher routes it.
The implementer opens a pull request. It cannot merge it.
Argo CD syncs the StatefulSet from Git.
The running pod keeps its old limit.
The alert fires again. Verdict: rollout-pending.
The dispatcher checks the namespace and the budget.
The restarter pauses on one delete of the alert's pod.
Yes #2: I approve that one call.
The pod comes back with the new limit.

final: One fix, two approvals: a merge for the change, a yes for the delete.
